value: SRMA: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA); State drinking water primacy agencies

The only binding federal requirement explicitly covering water-system cybersecurity; the RRA's required elements (incl. automated systems security) provide the gap-analysis scope. Use EPA's Water Cybersecurity Assessment Tool / CISA CPGs for control-level detail since statute is not prescriptive.
RRA and ERP contents; Customer PII, billing and payment card data; SCADA network diagrams and asset inventories; PCII (if submitted)

SCADA/HMI; PLCs and RTUs at treatment plants, pump stations and lift stations; Chemical dosing controls; Remote access / telemetry (cellular/radio); Laboratory information systems; Customer billing / AMI

No federal mandatory cyber incident-reporting rule for water systems as of 2026-09-25 (CIRCIA pending). EPA's 2023 sanitary-survey cyber memo was withdrawn (Oct. 2023) - not re-verified here. State rules (e.g., state PUC or state water cyber laws) may apply.
